commit.description: The Git commit of the catalog.

catalogRelease.description: CatalogRelease is the catalog release that the API was built from.

id.description: The file name of the component without .yaml.

sourceDigest.description:
The Go module hash (h1:) of components/<id>.yaml. A measurement with another sourceDigest
tested an older file.

componentEntry.description: ComponentEntry names a component. components/<id>.json holds the rest.

name.description: k3s, rke2 or kubesolo. A reader ignores a value it does not know.

pinnedDistribution.description: PinnedDistribution is the release of a distribution that e2e installs on the host.

id.description: The directory name of the template under templates/.

sourceDigest.description:
The Go module hash (h1:) of the directory templates/<id>/. A measurement with another
sourceDigest tested older files.

templateEntry.description: TemplateEntry names a template. templates/<id>.json holds the rest.

profiles.description: The profiles that every component describes.

kubernetes.description: The Kubernetes versions that every profile is rendered and schema-checked against.

distributions.description:
The release of each host distribution that e2e installs. A measurement at another
distributionVersion tested another release.

title: catalog.json
description:
CatalogFile is catalog.json: the catalog release, its test environments, its components and its
templates.
